t: Introduction and overview — RC-135 Rivet Joint
name: Introduction and overview — RC-135 Rivet Joint — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — RC-135 Rivet Joint
description: Introduction and overview of the RC-135 Rivet Joint: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The RC-135 Rivet Joint is a four-engine signals-intelligence aircraft built by Boeing, entering service in the 1960s with continuous upgrades since. It collects electronic emissions near denied areas, feeding intelligence to commanders in near real time. About 17 RC-135V/W aircraft serve the U.S. Air Force and RAF. Baseline facts: Signals-intelligence aircraft; service from the 1960s; ~17 RC-135V/W in U.S./UK service..
